{{Quote|Okay pal, you have two options. Either you can settle down nice and peaceably and stop bothering the other patrons, or you can be shipped off-planet, one body part at a time.|Leesa One-Eye|<ref name="RII" />}}
'''Leesa One-Eye''' was a one-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Born on a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Leesa left her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to become a [[free-trader]] until a run in with [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. The [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] deliberately injured her left eye with a blade. Leesa left the free-trader life and traveled to Ropagi II to work as hired security.
